reviews.text: Hello everyone, I purchased my first Diamond (with Gold) Jewellery on 30th November 2024 and it was also my first purchase experience from P.C.Chandra (Garia). I would like to thank Miss Sharmistha Dasgupta for her patience, co-operation and friendly behaviour regarding my first jewellery purchase which has emotional value. Highly recommended to all the buyers out there to visit this branch and they will get comfortable purchase experience for sure. Last but not least, I pray for your well-being and a healthy life miss Sharmistha Dasgupta because behaviour is the signature of a human character in any field. Thank you again!

Traditional jewelers in a dedicated multi storied facility. The collapsible gates give an impression they are perennially closed, but follow the hanging open sign and walk near - a guard will open the gate for you. Depending on what you are looking for you will then head to the ground, first, or second floor. Staff are well trained, attentive, quick to understand what the customers are looking for. Payment process takes a while. If you are exchanging gold then expect the gold valuation, billing, payment, packaging to take about an hour.

The support staff led by Koushik Banerjee is fantastic and very well behaved and polite. All the staff are very friendly and cordial. I visit this store quite often and I would recommend to everyone reading this review. A big thumbs up.

Very pleasant behaviour and friendly...her choice always valuable to me...her choice always make me comfortable and only one among everyone....in gold jewellery I am nothing without her....great Diyasha.
The outlet is very convenient to South Kolkata. The behaviours of the sales executive is very warm and cordial. Helps me to take decesion making of purchase. Overall it's a good experience.
Mr Kaushik Bannerjee is a very helpful person,and of good behaviour,thnks to him
Kaushik Banerjee,is a helpful person.we are so glad to purchase this gold.
